thread:
Maria Chen: thinking out loud — can we try a 'minimal per-request trace' default for hosted API? only provenance (route/model/tenant/id), timing, and a tiny redaction-hash instead of full req/resp. reduces storage and PII surface.
Alex Gupta: +1 on reducing PII surface. what's the UX though when an engineer needs the full payload to debug a customer bug?
Samir Patel: we could gate full payloads behind an inspect flow with ACL and an audit write to S3. default stored traces are tiny, then 'request_id -> inspect token' gets a 1h unmask.
Jen Owens: concern: product teams rely on heatmaps + sample traces on the dashboard to triage perf regressions. minimal traces might remove useful context (e.g., tokenization length distribution).
Maria Chen: fair. proposal: keep minimal traces for 99% by default. keep a very small sampled corpus (0.1% global + per-tenant adjustable) of full req/resps for observability. dashboard shows both aggregated metrics (from minimal) and links to sampled full traces.
Alex Gupta: do we have a quota model for sampled full traces? we should avoid tenants accidentally generating 10x storage if they call debug endpoints.
Samir Patel: yes — sampled full traces must count against tenant debug quota. defaults: 1000 full traces / month free, then bill or throttle. can be surfaced in console usage/alerts.
Jen Owens: UX for console: show sampling burn rate as a percent of debug quota under the route's dashboard, with a quick toggle to opt-in for higher sample rates for a short window.
Maria Chen: short toggle needs safety: require reason text + auto-revoke after TTL, and write a mandatory audit event.
insights-bot: deploy-bot: new PR to infra: rfr #5121 - add per-tenant debug-trace quota + inspect-token flow. https://git.internal/r/infra/5121
Alex Gupta: technical nit: how do we store redaction-hash? deterministic per-field salt? we'll need rotation for long-term reid risk.
Samir Patel: use per-tenant rotating salt + hmac(field_value, salt_version) + store salt_version in metadata. rotation will bump salt_version but older traces remain hashed with old version until rehashed in background (opt-in).
Maria Chen: also need classification heuristics so we don't include embeddings or attachments in sampled full traces unless explicitly allowed.
Jen Owens: attachments are big. default exclude attachments from sampled traces; provide `include_attachments=true` flag in the inspect flow that requires higher auth.
Alex Gupta: audit question: who can hit inspect? SRE + tenant owners + legal via a special runbook? how to represent in RBAC?
Samir Patel: propose roles: debug.viewer (can request inspect token), debug.approver (can approve long-lived inspection), debug.admin. Console request triggers approver flow for long TTLs.
Maria Chen: monitoring: add telemetry for three signals: 1) minimal-trace ingestion rate, 2) sampled-full ingestion rate, 3) inspect-token issue rate + approvals. hook alerts at 90p of quota burn.
insights-bot: metrics: created metric rwi.request.traces.minimal.count, rwi.request.traces.full.count, rwi.request.inspect.tokens. added to dashboard staging.
Jen Owens: dashboard design ask: show sampled-examples as anonymized snippets with fields redacted but with labels (e.g., <email-redacted>, <long-text-truncated>) so PMs can still validate intent.
Alex Gupta: also flag potential PII detection confidence on each sampled-full trace. CI for redaction heuristics.
Samir Patel: implementation details: minimal trace schema:
```
{ tenant_id, route, model, duration_ms, token_count_est, redaction_hashes: [h1,h2], salt_version }
```
full trace: store separately encrypted, KMS-wrapped, with access gating and TTL.
Maria Chen: timeline: PoC for minimal traces + quota UI in 2 weeks, inspect token flow + audit in 4 weeks. want to stage canary for 10 tenants.
Jen Owens: agree. can we pick 10 low-risk internal tenants + a single external beta customer?
Alex Gupta: ok from infra side. I'll queue infra PR review and add quota metering. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: I'll draft the rollout playbook and runbooks for incident escalations if inspect token abused.
Maria Chen: cool. I'll update the console mockups and add a small tooltip explaining what "minimal trace" includes. thanks all.
Alex Gupta: quick follow-up — we need a short note for legal about retention and salt rotation. I'll loop them in after PoC.
insights-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled Thu 9am to finalize samples/quotas. https://calendar.internal/evt/2439
